Adjusts the musical octave pitch offset of the output MIDI file (default is 3).
Sets the standard playback speed (Beats Per Minute) for the generated MIDI.
How sensitive the detector is to color changes. Higher value = easier detection but more noise. Recommended: 80-95.
Note events shorter than this will be ignored or forced to this length to avoid key flicker. Recommended: 0.02s for 60fps.
Adjust the pixel width of virtual piano keys to fit your video’s keyboard size.
Adjust the relative horizontal offset alignment for virtual black keys.
Specify the total number of piano keys visible in the video (usually 88 keys).
Allows simultaneous overlapping notes of the same pitch. Keep disabled for cleaner MIDI.
Enable to completely skip/ignore short noise clicks that are shorter than the Min Duration setting.
Enable if your video has glowing sparks rising above the keyboard to help improve note hit precision.
Experimental: Use alternative key mapping algorithms for non-standard Synthesia themes.
Analyzes neighboring keys to filter out false-positive duplicate triggers when lights bleed across keys.
Prioritize white key state changes when processing rollchecks.
Use individual color sensitivity variables from the Color Map list instead of a global value.
Auto-align starting times of notes played very close to each other (helps align chord keystrokes).
